47: @Provides
48: public class HandleStandardException extends JavacAnnotationHandler<StandardException> {
49: 	private static final Object REFERENCE_DEFAULT = null;
50: 
51: 	@Override
52: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<StandardException> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
53: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.STANDARD_EXCEPTION_FLAG_USAGE, "@StandardException");
54: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, StandardException.class);
55: 		deleteImportFromCompilationUnit(annotationNode, "lombok.AccessLevel");
56: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
57: 		
58: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
59: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException is only supported on a class");
60: 			return;
61: 		}
62: 		
63: 		JCTree extending = Javac.getExtendsClause((JCClassDecl) typeNode.get());
64: 		if (extending == null) {
65: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
66: 			return;
67: 		}
68: 		
69: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
70: 		if (access == null) access = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
71: 		if (access == AccessLevel.NONE) {
72: 			annotationNode.addError("AccessLevel.NONE is not valid here");
73: 			access = AccessLevel.PUBLIC;
74: 		}
75: 		
76: 		generateNoArgsConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
77: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
78: 		generateCauseOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
79: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
80: 	}
81: 	
82: 	private void generateNoArgsConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
83: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
84: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
85: 		
86: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(getDefaultExpr(typeNode, maker, null), getDefaultExpr(typeNode, maker, null));
87: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));
88: 		JCMethodDecl constr = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, false, source, List.of(thisCall));
89: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
90: 	}
91: 	
92: 	private void generateMsgOnlyConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
93: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
94: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
95: 		
96: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("message")), getDefaultExpr(typeNode, maker, null));
97: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));
98: 		JCMethodDecl constr = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, false, source, List.of(thisCall));
99: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
100: 	}
101: 	
102: 	private void generateCauseOnlyConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
103: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
104: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
105: 		Name causeName = typeNode.toName("cause");
106: 		
107: 		JCExpression causeDotGetMessage = maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(causeName), typeNode.toName("getMessage")), List.<JCExpression>nil());
108: 		JCExpression msgExpression = maker.Conditional(maker.Binary(CTC_NOT_EQUAL, maker.Ident(causeName), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null)), causeDotGetMessage, maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
109: 		
110: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(msgExpression, maker.Ident(causeName));
111: 		JCStatement thisCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("this")), args));
112: 		JCMethodDecl constr = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, true, source, List.of(thisCall));
113: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
114: 	}
115: 	
116: 	private void generateFullConstructor(JavacNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, JavacNode source) {
117: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
118: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
119: 		
120: 		Name causeName = typeNode.toName("cause");
121: 		Name superName = typeNode.toName("super");
122: 		
123: 		List<JCExpression> args = List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(typeNode.toName("message")));
124: 		JCStatement superCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Ident(superName), args));
125: 		JCExpression causeNotNull = maker.Binary(CTC_NOT_EQUAL, maker.Ident(causeName), maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, null));
126: 		JCStatement initCauseCall = maker.Exec(maker.Apply(List.<JCExpression>nil(), maker.Select(maker.Ident(superName), typeNode.toName("initCause")), List.<JCExpression>of(maker.Ident(causeName))));
127: 		JCStatement initCause = maker.If(causeNotNull, initCauseCall, null);
128: 		JCMethodDecl constr = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, true, source, List.of(superCall, initCause));
129: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constr);
130: 	}

132: 	public JCExpression getDefaultExpr(JavacNode typeNode, JavacTreeMaker maker, JCExpression type) {
133: 		if (maker == null) return null;
134: 
135: 		JCTree rawNode = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.get();
136: 		Kind kind = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.getKind();
137: 		JavacNode parent = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.directUp();
138: 		int pos = typeNode == null ? -1 : typeNode.getStartPos();
139: 
140: 		if (typeNode != null && typeNode.getAst() != null && rawNode instanceof JCClassDecl) {
141: 			JCClassDecl classDecl = (JCClassDecl) rawNode;
142: 			Name className = classDecl.name;
143: 			JCModifiers mods = classDecl.mods;
144: 			List<JCTree> defs = classDecl.defs;
145: 			boolean hasChildren = typeNode.down() != null && !typeNode.down().isEmpty();
146: 			if (classDecl.pos >= 0) pos = classDecl.pos;
147: 			long flags = mods == null ? 0L : mods.flags;
148: 			if ((flags & Flags.INTERFACE) != 0) {
149: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, REFERENCE_DEFAULT);
150: 			}
151: 			if (className == null && (defs == null || defs.isEmpty()) && !hasChildren && kind != Kind.TYPE) {
152: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, REFERENCE_DEFAULT);
153: 			}
154: 			if (pos < 0 && parent != null) {
155: 				pos = parent.getStartPos();
156: 			}
157: 		}
158: 
159: 		if (pos < 0 && type == null) {
160: 			return maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, REFERENCE_DEFAULT);
161: 		}
162: 
163: 		if (type instanceof JCPrimitiveTypeTree) {
164: 			switch (((JCPrimitiveTypeTree) type).getPrimitiveTypeKind()) {
165: 			case BOOLEAN:
166: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_BOOLEAN, 0);
167: 			case CHAR:
168: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_CHAR, 0);
169: 			default:
170: 			case BYTE:
171: 			case SHORT:
172: 			case INT:
173: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_INT, 0);
174: 			case LONG:
175: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_LONG, 0L);
176: 			case FLOAT:
177: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_FLOAT, 0F);
178: 			case DOUBLE:
179: 				return maker.Literal(CTC_DOUBLE, 0D);
180: 			}
181: 		}
182: 
183: 		return maker.Literal(CTC_BOT, REFERENCE_DEFAULT);
184: 	}

186: 	private static MemberExistsResult hasConstructor(JavacNode node, Class<?>... paramTypes) {
187: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);
188: 		
189: 		if (node != null && node.get() instanceof JCClassDecl) {
190: 			for (JCTree def : ((JCClassDecl) node.get()).defs) {
191: 				if (def instanceof JCMethodDecl) {
192: 					JCMethodDecl md = (JCMethodDecl) def;
193: 					if (md.name.contentEquals("<init>") && (md.mods.flags & Flags.GENERATEDCONSTR) == 0) {
194: 						if (!paramsMatch(node, md.params, paramTypes)) continue;
195: 						return getGeneratedBy(def) == null ? MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER : MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK;
196: 					}
197: 				}
198: 			}
199: 		}
200: 		
201: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
202: 	}
203: 	
204: 	private static boolean paramsMatch(JavacNode node, List<JCVariableDecl> a, Class<?>[] b) {
205: 		if (a == null) return b == null || b.length == 0;
206: 		if (b == null) return a.size() == 0;
207: 		if (a.size() != b.length) return false;
208: 		
209: 		for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
210: 			JCVariableDecl param = a.get(i);
211: 			Class<?> c = b[i];
212: 			if (!typeMatches(c, node, param.vartype)) return false;
213: 		}
214: 		
215: 		return true;
216: 	}
217: 
218: 	private static void addConstructorProperties(JCModifiers mods, JavacNode node, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam) {
219: 		if (!msgParam && !causeParam) return;
220: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = node.getTreeMaker();
221: 		JCExpression constructorPropertiesType = chainDots(node, "java", "beans", "ConstructorProperties");
222: 		ListBuffer<JCExpression> fieldNames = new ListBuffer<JCExpression>();
223: 		if (msgParam) fieldNames.append(maker.Literal("message"));
224: 		if (causeParam) fieldNames.append(maker.Literal("cause"));
225: 		JCExpression fieldNamesArray = maker.NewArray(null, List.<JCExpression>nil(), fieldNames.toList());
226: 		JCAnnotation annotation = maker.Annotation(constructorPropertiesType, List.of(fieldNamesArray));
227: 		mods.annotations = mods.annotations.append(annotation);
228: 	}
229: 	
230: 	@SuppressWarnings("deprecation") private static JCMethodDecl createConstructor(AccessLevel level, JavacNode typeNode, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam, JavacNode source, List<JCStatement> statements) {
231: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = typeNode.getTreeMaker();
232: 		
233: 		boolean addConstructorProperties;
234: 		if ((!msgParam && !causeParam) || isLocalType(typeNode) || !LombokOptionsFactory.getDelombokOptions(typeNode.getContext()).getFormatPreferences().generateConstructorProperties()) {
235: 			addConstructorProperties = false;
236: 		} else {
237: 			Boolean v = typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_ADD_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES);
238: 			addConstructorProperties = v != null ? v.booleanValue() :
239: 				Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_SUPPRESS_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES));
240: 		}
241: 		
242: 		ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl> params = new ListBuffer<JCVariableDecl>();
243: 		
244: 		if (msgParam) {
245: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("message");
246: 			long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, typeNode.getContext());
247: 			JCExpression pType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "String");
248: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
249: 			params.append(param);
250: 		}
251: 		
252: 		if (causeParam) {
253: 			Name fieldName = typeNode.toName("cause");
254: 			long flags = JavacHandlerUtil.addFinalIfNeeded(Flags.PARAMETER, typeNode.getContext());
255: 			JCExpression pType = genJavaLangTypeRef(typeNode, "Throwable");
256: 			JCVariableDecl param = maker.VarDef(maker.Modifiers(flags), fieldName, pType, null);
257: 			params.append(param);
258: 		}
259: 		
260: 		JCModifiers mods = maker.Modifiers(toJavacModifier(level), List.<JCAnnotation>nil());
261: 		if (addConstructorProperties) addConstructorProperties(mods, typeNode, msgParam, causeParam);
262: 		return recursiveSetGeneratedBy(maker.MethodDef(mods, typeNode.toName("<init>"),
263: 			null, List.<JCTypeParameter>nil(), params.toList(), List.<JCExpression>nil(),
264: 			maker.Block(0L, statements), null), source);
265: 	}
266: 	
267: 	public static boolean isLocalType(JavacNode type) {
268: 		Kind kind = type.up().getKind();
269: 		if (kind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return false;
270: 		if (kind == Kind.TYPE) return isLocalType(type.up());
271: 		return true;
272: 	}

47: 	private static final int DEFAULT_SOURCE_POSITION = 0;
48: 
49: 	@Override
50: 	public void handle(AnnotationValues<StandardException> annotation, Annotation ast, EclipseNode annotationNode) {
51: 		handleFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.STANDARD_EXCEPTION_FLAG_USAGE, "@StandardException");
52: 		
53: 		EclipseNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
54: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
55: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException is only supported on a class");
56: 			return;
57: 		}
58: 		
59: 		TypeDeclaration classDef = (TypeDeclaration) typeNode.get();
60: 		if (classDef.superclass == null) {
61: 			annotationNode.addError("@StandardException requires that you extend a Throwable type");
62: 			return;
63: 		}
64: 		
65: 		AccessLevel access = annotation.getInstance().access();
66: 		
67: 		generateNoArgsConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
68: 		generateMsgOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
69: 		generateCauseOnlyConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
70: 		generateFullConstructor(typeNode, access, annotationNode);
71: 	}

73: 	private void generateNoArgsConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
74: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
75: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
76: 		
77: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
78: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {getDefaultExpr(typeNode, null, pS, pE), getDefaultExpr(typeNode, null, pS, pE)};
79: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, false, source, explicitCall, null);
80: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
81: 	}

83: 	private void generateMsgOnlyConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
84: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
85: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
86: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
87: 		
88: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
89: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p), getDefaultExpr(typeNode, null, pS, pE)};
90: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, false, source, explicitCall, null);
91: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
92: 	}

95: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
96: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
97: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
98: 		
99: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.This);
100: 		Expression causeNotNull = new EqualExpression(new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE), OperatorIds.NOT_EQUAL);
101: 		MessageSend causeDotGetMessage = new MessageSend();
102: 		causeDotGetMessage.sourceStart = pS; causeDotGetMessage.sourceEnd = pE;
103: 		causeDotGetMessage.receiver = new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p);
104: 		causeDotGetMessage.selector = GET_MESSAGE;
105: 		Expression messageExpr = new ConditionalExpression(causeNotNull, causeDotGetMessage, new NullLiteral(pS, pE));
106: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {messageExpr, new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p)};
107: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, false, true, source, explicitCall, null);
108: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
109: 	}

111: 	private void generateFullConstructor(EclipseNode typeNode, AccessLevel level, EclipseNode source) {
112: 		if (hasConstructor(typeNode, String.class, Throwable.class) != MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS) return;
113: 		int pS = source.get().sourceStart, pE = source.get().sourceEnd;
114: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
115: 		
116: 		ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall = new ExplicitConstructorCall(ExplicitConstructorCall.Super);
117: 		explicitCall.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(MESSAGE, p)};
118: 		Expression causeNotNull = new EqualExpression(new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p), new NullLiteral(pS, pE), OperatorIds.NOT_EQUAL);
119: 		MessageSend causeDotInitCause = new MessageSend();
120: 		causeDotInitCause.sourceStart = pS; causeDotInitCause.sourceEnd = pE;
121: 		causeDotInitCause.receiver = new SuperReference(pS, pE);
122: 		causeDotInitCause.selector = INIT_CAUSE;
123: 		causeDotInitCause.arguments = new Expression[] {new SingleNameReference(CAUSE, p)};
124: 		IfStatement ifs = new IfStatement(causeNotNull, causeDotInitCause, pS, pE);
125: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = createConstructor(level, typeNode, true, true, source, explicitCall, ifs);
126: 		injectMethod(typeNode, constructor);
127: 	}

129: 	public Expression getDefaultExpr(EclipseNode typeNode, TypeReference type, int s, int e) {
130: 		ASTNode rawNode = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.get();
131: 		Kind kind = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.getKind();
132: 		EclipseNode parent = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.directUp();
133: 		EclipseAST ast = typeNode == null ? null : typeNode.getAst();
134: 
135: 		int fallback = DEFAULT_SOURCE_POSITION;
136: 		int start = s;
137: 		int end = e;
138: 		if (rawNode != null) {
139: 			if (start < 0) start = rawNode.sourceStart;
140: 			if (end < 0) end = rawNode.sourceEnd;
141: 		}
142: 		if (start < 0) start = fallback;
143: 		if (end < 0) end = fallback;
144: 
145: 		boolean completeParse = ast != null && ast.isCompleteParse();
146: 		if (rawNode instanceof TypeDeclaration) {
147: 			TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = (TypeDeclaration) rawNode;
148: 			char[] typeName = typeDeclaration.name;
149: 			int modifiers = typeDeclaration.modifiers;
150: 			TypeReference superclass = typeDeclaration.superclass;
151: 			FieldDeclaration[] fields = typeDeclaration.fields;
152: 			if ((modifiers & ClassFileConstants.AccInterface) != 0) {
153: 				return new NullLiteral(start, end);
154: 			}
155: 			if (typeName == null && superclass == null && (fields == null || fields.length == 0) && kind != Kind.TYPE) {
156: 				return new NullLiteral(start, end);
157: 			}
158: 			if (start < 0 && parent != null && parent.get() != null) {
159: 				start = parent.get().sourceStart;
160: 				end = parent.get().sourceEnd;
161: 			}
162: 			if (!completeParse && type == null) {
163: 				return new NullLiteral(start, end);
164: 			}
165: 		}
166: 
167: 		if (type instanceof ArrayTypeReference) return new NullLiteral(start, end);
168: 		if (type != null) {
169: 			char[] lastToken = type.getLastToken();
170: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.BOOLEAN, lastToken)) return new FalseLiteral(start, end);
171: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.CHAR, lastToken)) return new CharLiteral(new char[] {'\'', '\\', '0', '\''}, start, end);
172: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.BYTE, lastToken) || Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.SHORT, lastToken) ||
173: 				Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.INT, lastToken)) return IntLiteral.buildIntLiteral(new char[] {'0'}, start, end);
174: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.LONG, lastToken)) return LongLiteral.buildLongLiteral(new char[] {'0',  'L'}, start, end);
175: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.FLOAT, lastToken)) return new FloatLiteral(new char[] {'0', 'F'}, start, end);
176: 			if (Arrays.equals(TypeConstants.DOUBLE, lastToken)) return new DoubleLiteral(new char[] {'0', 'D'}, start, end);
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		return new NullLiteral(start, end);
180: 	}

182: 	/**
183: 	 * Checks if a constructor with the provided parameters exists under the type node.
184: 	 */
185: 	public static MemberExistsResult hasConstructor(EclipseNode node, Class<?>... paramTypes) {
186: 		node = upToTypeNode(node);
187: 		
188: 		if (node != null && node.get() instanceof TypeDeclaration) {
189: 			TypeDeclaration typeDecl = (TypeDeclaration) node.get();
190: 			if (typeDecl.methods != null) for (AbstractMethodDeclaration def : typeDecl.methods) {
191: 				if (def instanceof ConstructorDeclaration) {
192: 					if ((def.bits & ASTNode.IsDefaultConstructor) != 0) continue;
193: 					if (!paramsMatch(node, def.arguments, paramTypes)) continue;
194: 					return getGeneratedBy(def) == null ? MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_USER : MemberExistsResult.EXISTS_BY_LOMBOK;
195: 				}
196: 			}
197: 		}
198: 		
199: 		return MemberExistsResult.NOT_EXISTS;
200: 	}
201: 	
202: 	private static boolean paramsMatch(EclipseNode node, Argument[] a, Class<?>[] b) {
203: 		if (a == null) return b == null || b.length == 0;
204: 		if (b == null) return a.length == 0;
205: 		if (a.length != b.length) return false;
206: 		
207: 		for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
208: 			if (!typeMatches(b[i], node, a[i].type)) return false;
209: 		}
210: 		return true;
211: 	}

213: 	private static final char[][] JAVA_BEANS_CONSTRUCTORPROPERTIES = new char[][] { "java".toCharArray(), "beans".toCharArray(), "ConstructorProperties".toCharArray() };
214: 	private static final char[] MESSAGE = "message".toCharArray(), CAUSE = "cause".toCharArray(), GET_MESSAGE = "getMessage".toCharArray(), INIT_CAUSE = "initCause".toCharArray();
215: 	
216: 	public static Annotation[] createConstructorProperties(ASTNode source, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam) {
217: 		if (!msgParam && !causeParam) return null;
218: 		
219: 		int pS = source.sourceStart, pE = source.sourceEnd;
220: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
221: 		long[] poss = new long[3];
222: 		Arrays.fill(poss, p);
223: 		
224: 		QualifiedTypeReference constructorPropertiesType = new QualifiedTypeReference(JAVA_BEANS_CONSTRUCTORPROPERTIES, poss);
225: 		setGeneratedBy(constructorPropertiesType, source);
226: 		SingleMemberAnnotation ann = new SingleMemberAnnotation(constructorPropertiesType, pS);
227: 		ann.declarationSourceEnd = pE;
228: 		
229: 		ArrayInitializer fieldNames = new ArrayInitializer();
230: 		fieldNames.sourceStart = pS;
231: 		fieldNames.sourceEnd = pE;
232: 		fieldNames.expressions = new Expression[(msgParam && causeParam) ? 2 : 1];
233: 		
234: 		int ctr = 0;
235: 		if (msgParam) {
236: 			fieldNames.expressions[ctr] = new StringLiteral(MESSAGE, pS, pE, 0);
237: 			setGeneratedBy(fieldNames.expressions[ctr], source);
238: 			ctr++;
239: 		}
240: 		if (causeParam) {
241: 			fieldNames.expressions[ctr] = new StringLiteral(CAUSE, pS, pE, 0);
242: 			setGeneratedBy(fieldNames.expressions[ctr], source);
243: 			ctr++;
244: 		}
245: 		
246: 		ann.memberValue = fieldNames;
247: 		setGeneratedBy(ann, source);
248: 		setGeneratedBy(ann.memberValue, source);
249: 		return new Annotation[] { ann };
250: 	}

252: 	@SuppressWarnings("deprecation") public static ConstructorDeclaration createConstructor(AccessLevel level, EclipseNode typeNode, boolean msgParam, boolean causeParam, EclipseNode sourceNode, ExplicitConstructorCall explicitCall, Statement extra) {
253: 		ASTNode source = sourceNode.get();
254: 		TypeDeclaration typeDeclaration = ((TypeDeclaration) typeNode.get());
255: 		int pS = source.sourceStart, pE = source.sourceEnd;
256: 		long p = (long) pS << 32 | pE;
257: 		
258: 		boolean addConstructorProperties;
259: 		if ((!msgParam && !causeParam) || isLocalType(typeNode)) {
260: 			addConstructorProperties = false;
261: 		} else {
262: 			Boolean v = typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_ADD_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES);
263: 			addConstructorProperties = v != null ? v.booleanValue() :
264: 				Boolean.FALSE.equals(typeNode.getAst().readConfiguration(ConfigurationKeys.ANY_CONSTRUCTOR_SUPPRESS_CONSTRUCTOR_PROPERTIES));
265: 		}
266: 		
267: 		ConstructorDeclaration constructor = new ConstructorDeclaration(((CompilationUnitDeclaration) typeNode.top().get()).compilationResult);
268: 		
269: 		constructor.modifiers = toEclipseModifier(level);
270: 		constructor.selector = typeDeclaration.name;
271: 		constructor.thrownExceptions = null;
272: 		constructor.typeParameters = null;
273: 		constructor.bits |= ECLIPSE_DO_NOT_TOUCH_FLAG;
274: 		constructor.bodyStart = constructor.declarationSourceStart = constructor.sourceStart = pS;
275: 		constructor.bodyEnd = constructor.declarationSourceEnd = constructor.sourceEnd = pE;
276: 		constructor.arguments = null;
277: 		
278: 		List<Argument> params = new ArrayList<Argument>();
279: 		
280: 		if (msgParam) {
281: 			TypeReference typeRef = new QualifiedTypeReference(TypeConstants.JAVA_LANG_STRING, new long[] {p, p, p});
282: 			Argument parameter = new Argument(MESSAGE, p, typeRef, Modifier.FINAL);
283: 			params.add(parameter);
284: 		}
285: 		if (causeParam) {
286: 			TypeReference typeRef = new QualifiedTypeReference(TypeConstants.JAVA_LANG_THROWABLE, new long[] {p, p, p});
287: 			Argument parameter = new Argument(CAUSE, p, typeRef, Modifier.FINAL);
288: 			params.add(parameter);
289: 		}
290: 		
291: 		explicitCall.sourceStart = pS;
292: 		explicitCall.sourceEnd = pE;
293: 		constructor.constructorCall = explicitCall;
294: 		constructor.statements = extra != null ? new Statement[] {extra} : null;
295: 		constructor.arguments = params.isEmpty() ? null : params.toArray(new Argument[0]);
296: 		
297: 		Annotation[] constructorProperties = null;
298: 		if (addConstructorProperties) constructorProperties = createConstructorProperties(source, msgParam, causeParam);
299: 		constructor.annotations = copyAnnotations(source, constructorProperties);
300: 		constructor.traverse(new SetGeneratedByVisitor(source), typeDeclaration.scope);
301: 		return constructor;
302: 	}

305: 		Kind kind = type.up().getKind();
306: 		if (kind == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return false;
307: 		if (kind == Kind.TYPE) return isLocalType(type.up());
308: 		return true;
309: 	}
